title: Oikonomou2016 – SSVEP MAMEM 3 dataset
description: A comparative evaluation dataset of steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) based brain-computer interfaces, comprising 14-channel EEG recordings from 11 healthy subjects performing attention tasks on flickering visual stimuli at five different frequencies (6.66–12.00 Hz). The dataset includes preprocessed signals, artifact annotations, and comprehensive documentation of signal processing pipelines for benchmarking state-of-the-art BCI algorithms. EEG signals were acquired using an EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System (GES 300) with 14 channels at 128 Hz sampling rate.
methods_description: EEG signals were acquired using an EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System (GES 300) with 14 channels at 128 Hz sampling rate. Subjects focused on magenta boxes flickering at frequencies of 6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00, and 12.00 Hz presented on a 22-inch LCD monitor. Each trial lasted 5 seconds followed by 5 seconds of rest. Preprocessing included bandpass filtering (5–48 Hz), notch filtering (50 Hz), artifact removal using AMUSE and ICA, and common average reference (CAR) re-referencing. The study employed leave-one-subject-out cross-validation to evaluate state-of-the-art algorithms for filtering, artifact removal, feature extraction, feature selection, and classification.
